title: 2013 Colombian clashes
summary: The English Wikipedia article "2013 Colombian clashes", at revision 1370423552, opens: "On 20 July 2013, two clashes occurred in Colombia between government forces and Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC) guerrillas. Nineteen soldiers were killed in the deadliest day since peace talks began in November 2012. The conflict came one day after a FARC-EP officer, Alejandra, had detained with a chain around the neck a vacationing U.S. Army Combat Engineer (12B) veteran, Kevin Scott Sutay, including for his 27th birthday in the jungle on October 13, to try to further anger him intentionally." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q14186580, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "2013 engagement between Colombian military forces and FARC guerillas".
